decision_rationale: This is a pre-trained DNA language model, but the provided evidence centers on masked language modeling and masked-token prediction rather than a genuinely generative architecture. It does show broad pretraining on 65 angiosperm genomes and transferable zero-shot use.
evidence_snippet: masked language modeling objective; masked token prediction accuracy; pre-trained on 65 angiosperm genomes; zero-shot testing shows transferable performance across species

decision_rationale: The paper explicitly presents a transcriptomics-based molecule generation framework and describes generation of personalized therapeutic compounds. It also combines a single-cell RNA-seq foundation model with a molecular GPT and shows cross-cell-type generalization.
evidence_snippet: transcriptomics-based molecule generation framework; couples a single-cell RNA-sequencing foundation model with a molecular GPT model; generate distinct molecules for different cell types

decision_rationale: This is a genuinely generative model paper because it adds a denoising diffusion module to masked-language-model pretraining and uses diffusion-based post-training. The corpus is large-scale and the model is framed as a foundation for virtual cell modeling across studies.
evidence_snippet: context-aware transformer model augmented with a denoising diffusion module; diffusion-driven post-training; 34.2 million cells included for further analysis

decision_rationale: The framework applies an existing protein language model, ESM-2, in a zero-shot scoring setup rather than introducing a new generative model. The evidence is a wrapper around masked-token likelihood scoring for risk quantification.
evidence_snippet: applies the protein language model ESM-2, without fine-tuning; masked-token log-likelihood ratios; zero-shot structural risk quantification

decision_rationale: Raygun is explicitly described as an auto-encoder with decoder-side generation and generative sampling. It is also pretrained on ~80,000 UniRef50 proteins and used for broad sequence modification tasks.
evidence_snippet: "auto-encoder"; "support generative sampling"; "trained on around 80,000 proteins from UniRef50"; "single-shot generation"

decision_rationale: Unify is presented as a transfer learning framework for universal cell embeddings and cross-species prediction, not a generative architecture. The evidence supports broad transferable representations but not generation.
evidence_snippet: "learns universal cell embeddings"; "transfer learning methodology"; "combining RNA expression with embeddings"; "prediction of perturbation responses across species"

decision_rationale: scMIR is a pretrained vision-language foundation model with strong transferable representations, but the provided sections only show self-supervised image reconstruction and text-guided alignment. They do not clearly establish a genuinely generative text-bio mechanism.
evidence_snippet: "self-supervised image reconstruction with text-guided cross-modal alignment"; "pretrained on 207,957 image-text pairs"; "task-agnostic image embeddings"

decision_rationale: CellDuality fine-tunes and steers an existing LLM for biological reasoning with SFT and self-supervised RLVR, so the contribution is an application wrapper rather than a new foundational model. The record does show autoregressive text generation, but not candidate-model foundation pretraining.
evidence_snippet: "output is a textual response y, generated autoregressively according to the policy"; "leveraging powerful teacher models"; "Supervised Fine-Tuning"; "RLVR"

decision_rationale: The system does generate natural-language explanations, but the core stack is a Qwen3.5-9B backbone plus LoRA adapters, a plugin GNN, and an agent layer rather than a new generative foundation model. The evidence supports a wrapper built around an existing LLM.
evidence_snippet: a single nine-billion-parameter language model (Qwen3.5-9B); generates natural-language explanations of its predictions; a Planner-Router-Verifier natural-language interface

decision_rationale: The selected text describes a system built around a shared Qwen3.5-9B backbone and external foundation models, including report generation via GPT-4o and o1. That makes it an application framework/wrapper rather than a primary generative foundation model.
evidence_snippet: spEMO can generate medical reports with a multi-modal instruction setting; Our multi-modal agents used in this task are GPT-4o and o1; shared Qwen3.5-9B backbone

decision_rationale: The record is an empirical analysis of existing single-cell foundation models, not a new generative model paper. It studies representational geometry and probe behavior across scBERT, Geneformer, scGPT, and UCE.
evidence_snippet: We conduct a systematic empirical analysis of four SCFMs spanning 8.9M–650M parameters; across six families of analyses

decision_rationale: The provided evidence is too truncated to establish a generative architecture or a foundation-model-like candidate. What is visible is a literature-derived network construction step, not a generative text-bio foundation model.
